The text says it can serve as a keylogger, information stealer, botnet or backdoor, and that it is spread through email and drive-by downloads. It also says SmokeLoader was the first to use PROPagate injection, which runs code inside a different application from the one that is running. The text is only an introduction excerpt, so it names no actors, sectors, countries, CVEs or figures.
